title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Framework renewal: two-year volume commitment
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Forecast fc:350020@2026-09 shows 4,580 units annually, an increase of 10.3%, supporting a firm two-year commitment.

Contract ctr:4600070530 provides 90-day payment terms; we would prefer to retain these.

Could you provide a cost bridge from the existing price, including productivity offsets and the margin needed for sustainable supply? What price improvement could you offer against a firm 24-month commitment? Alternatively, please quantify the saving available for 30-day payment.

We propose the following fixed-price package, retaining the quoted delivery and quality terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Framework renewal: two-year volume commitment
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month commitment and 90-day payment terms, which we are prepared to support. While our base pricing is currently frozen by our head office, the extended contract duration enables us to offer a revised unit price of €432.94. 

Consequently, our offer stands at a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our colleagues will address your inquiries regarding the cost breakdown, margin, and the specific impacts of payment terms separately. Please note that our margin and our limits stay internal. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Framework renewal: payment alternatives and sustainable pricing
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for supporting the two-year commitment and existing payment terms.

Forecast fc:350020@2026-09 confirms 4,580 units annually, providing a stable basis for production planning.

Could an earlier-payment concession be approved separately from the base-price freeze? Please evaluate the two packages below and indicate your best sustainable price for each. Could you also provide the requested cost bridge and clarify the operating margin each package supports? We want a durable fixed-price agreement rather than savings that undermine supply continuity.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Framework renewal: payment alternatives and sustainable pricing
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

We have already taken that volume change data into account. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

We appreciate your flexibility in proposing a 30-day payment term, which allows us to provide a concession despite the base-price freeze. For the package with a 24-month commitment and 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised unit price of €430.01.

Please note that our operating margin and detailed cost bridge remain internal and cannot be shared. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Framework renewal: closing proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for clarifying the earlier-payment option. The €2.93 unit saving does not offset the financing value of retaining 90-day payment, so we prefer that structure.

We respect the confidentiality of your internal margins. Could you confirm whether €425.00 with a firm 24-month commitment is sustainable, or provide your closest approvable package? Could a contract-specific productivity rebate bridge the remaining difference without changing your published base price?

Our proposal retains the quoted delivery and quality terms and fixed pricing throughout the agreement.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Framework renewal: closing proposal
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We acknowledge your preference for retaining the 90-day payment terms alongside the 24-month commitment. Please be advised that our base price freeze applies to all forms of discounts, including contract-specific productivity rebates. 

Consequently, our offer must remain at €432.94 per unit for this package. To summarize, our Angebot comprises a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Renewal: longer-term fixed-price option
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for clarifying the scope of the price freeze. Rather than revisit the unchanged package, could a 36-month commitment unlock a separate duration concession while retaining fixed pricing and 90-day payment?

Please evaluate the proposed package below and provide your closest sustainable offer. Would 14-day payment unlock a materially larger concession than the previously quoted 30-day option? Please quantify that alternative for comparison, retaining the annual volume and all other quoted terms.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal: longer-term fixed-price option
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have evaluated your proposal for a 36-month commitment; however, our base price freeze applies strictly across all contract durations. Therefore, we can offer the 36-month agreement with 90-day payment terms at the unchanged price of €432.94 per unit.

Our current Angebot consists of a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
